text_block_list.text:
The lord of the castle has won—I am the

undisputed Overlord! Nothing short of
obsession
will suffice to defeat a ruler.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
That is what I say to my potential eternal

adversary... And it is also what I say to
myself.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Look around at what my feats have
produced—a
horde of enemies
threatening to hinder my true
stride. Lo!
A challenge worthy of a king if I've
ever
seen one!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to press forward and
build a
dynasty. My nation will witness
its foundation at
the Japan Cup!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
